intelligence.human_view: The lesson is not "build Connections" — it is "the proper system already exists, go and get it". Shawn's eye knew the shape before any brief did: a rectangle that scrolls down, click a person, the initial on the side, scroll through them as you go, or search — pro-like, like a messenger, not like a page of links. The round's discipline was to harvest the live room first-hand (never the stale Nov 15 snapshot) and to measure against it: the room's name column is 198px, the first build's was 78px, and the names wrapped — the checker caught exactly that, and the fix was 20 lines in one CSS spot. That is what harvesting means: the reference is the judge, and the gap is measured in pixels, not opinions. The person view carries the same lesson forward: Mail, Instant message, Audio call, Video call, Save contact, Connect, Add note — the room is the system, and the notes on a person (C3) ride inside it.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine you want to build the best toy box ever — but your friend already HAS one, a beautiful one, with little doors and drawers! You don't build a new one from scratch. You go look at your friend's toy box, you learn how it works, and you bring that clever design home. That's harvesting: the good thing already exists, so you take it and make it yours!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — if your neighbour has the perfect recipe, you don't invent a new one in your kitchen, you go and ask for hers. The proper Connections was already there, in the live room — a lovely scrolling list, click a face, the letter on the side, search when you want. We went and looked at it properly, measured it, and brought it home. That's the sensible way.
intelligence.naya_view: Connections is the proper system — a rectangle mini-messenger: scroll down, click, the initial on the side, or search. Harvest the room; don't rebuild it.
